links.note: Which method gives an accurate pH value - a pH-scale measurement item (57). KEY DEFECT: the marked answer is 'Universal indicator', which gives only an approximate value; the pH meter (option A) is the accurate method.
Universal indicator is a mixture of many indicators - what the indicator IS (47), as against reading a value off the scale (57).
pH paper cannot be used directly on solid sodium bicarbonate because pH is defined for a solution (57).
Milk of magnesia relieves acidity - the antacid application of pH in everyday life (59).
Antacid treats indigestion (59). Duplicate of qid:84930.
Acid + base gives salt and water, chosen over 'neutral solution' - the definition of neutralisation (51).
The false statement is that all metal oxides react with water to give salt and acid; picking it requires knowing metal oxides are basic and react with ACIDS to give salt and water (52).
